While in service to [[Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo/Legends|Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo]], the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zatch (bounty hunter)|Zatch]] utilized this '''speeder''' to travel on long distances, as well as participating in high-speed chases.<ref name="The Runaway Ride" />
